modalities.evidence: the raw and pre-processed fMRI data and structural images (T1)

output.population: 15 volunteers (10 female), ages 19 to 28, 14 right-handed, no history of dyslexia or other cognitive disorders
output.summary: Raw and preprocessed fMRI plus T1 structural images from 15 volunteers, acquired on a 3T GE scanner, for a study of word-recognition-related modulations in visual cortex.
